name: io.github.Leviathan0x0/chronicle-mcp
title: Chronicle MCP
description: Local, private AI chat history search & memory: BM25 over your Cursor, Claude and ChatGPT chats.

environmentVariables.name: CHRONICLE_BASE_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folder for the chat archive and search index. Defaults to ~/.chronicle (or the folder saved with chronicle --chats-folder).

environmentVariables.name: TRANSCRIPTS_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Override folder scanned by sync_workspace_data(source_type='agent_transcripts'). Defaults to each editor's own transcript folder.
